terra.problem: The gift-box comparison says the inheritance has already been handed over. The verse says God chooses it, not when it is received.
The verse says God chooses the inheritance, but does not say the people receive it.
The footnote line jokes about how Scripture is written.
The verse calls the inheritance the pride of Jacob; it does not call Jacob the pride of Jacob.
Calling the ascension a send-off adds a farewell to the scene that the verse does not describe.
Saying nobody is hiding behind flour sacks adds an invented detail to the scene.
The joke about someone rushing God out of His chair makes God and His throne the subject of the joke.
Moses is identified as Israel's leader without a reference for that fact from outside the passage.
Elijah is identified as a prophet without a reference for that fact from outside the passage.
The line about the nobles bringing God a seat invents an action the psalm does not describe.
The invented line about bringing God a seat makes Him the subject of the joke.
